      Alphabet Inc. Class A (GOOGL) stock is trading around $273-$275 as of late March 2026, with a market capitalization exceeding $3.3 trillion
      . Despite a year-to-date decline of over 12%, analysts maintain a generally positive outlook, driven by AI advancements, Google Cloud Platform, and Waymo, with recent price targets raised to as high as $397. 
      Key Stock Statistics (as of March 30, 2026): 
      • Price: ~$273.50
      • 52-Week Range: $140.53 - $349.00
      • P/E Ratio: ~25.3
      • Dividend Yield: ~0.3% 
      Recent Developments & Outlook: 
      • Performance: The stock has seen pressure in early 2026 due to valuation concerns and geopolitical tensions, falling over 12% YTD.
      • AI Focus: Alphabet is considered a key AI player, with analysts highlighting its Tensor Processing Units (TPUs).
      • Growth Drivers: Continued demand for Google Cloud and Waymo are seen as key long-term drivers.
      • Analyst Rating: Wells Fargo recently raised its price target to $397, maintaining an "Overweight" rating. 
      The company is set to report earnings on April 23, 2026.

      Overview

      Description

      Alphabet Inc. is an American multinational technology conglomerate holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California. It was created through a restructuring of Google on October 2, 2015, and became the parent holding company of Google and several former Google subsidiaries. Wikipedia
      Headquarters: Mountain View, CA
      Number of employees: 190,820 (2025)
      CEO: Sundar Pichai (Dec 3, 2019–)
      Revenue: 350 billion USD (2024)
      Founded: October 2, 2015, California
      Founders: Larry Page, Sergey Brin
      Subsidiaries: Google, Waymo, Google Fiber, DeepMind · See more
